headlines.text: It was 2025 when Kevin Knight touched down in AEW for the first time against Jay White, appearing on Collision, rated 6.72.

Looking back to 2024, when Adam Copeland vs. Matt Cardona fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.54 ? a good, competitive contest. For Matt Cardona, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
Flash back to 2022, when Bryan Danielson vs. Wheeler Yuta delivered a genuinely great match on Dynamite, rated 8.03.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when Jamie Hayter vs. Billie Starkz headlined Collision, rated 7.43 ? a good, competitive contest in a big night for the women's side of the roster.
Back on this day in 2024, Castagnoli & Danielson & Shibata went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.15 ? a match that delivered.
2022 brought us this moment: Toni Storm kicked off their AEW journey against The Bunny, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.09.
